initial_failures.resolution: Used an absolute isolated output directory.

initial_failures.failure: A row-returning SELECT guard preceded later statements in td_initialize expansion.
initial_failures.resolution: Used the existing non-row-returning error-guard pattern; exact version/cardinality checks preserved.

initial_failures.failure: Adversarial replay test removed catalog revision and expected replay despite corrupt format metadata.
initial_failures.resolution: Kept strict global metadata audit and narrowed replay contract/test to otherwise valid oversized current state and reduced budgets.

initial_failures.failure: Owned rollback attempted invalidation SQL inside an aborted transaction before ROLLBACK.
initial_failures.resolution: Dispatch ROLLBACK first, then conservatively invalidate ownership; preserve returned rollback rows.
